=== enter between tags
--- before
<div>¦</div>
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
<div>
    ¦
</div>

=== autoclose attribute quote
--- before
<a href=¦>
--- keys
"x
--- after
<a href="x¦">

=== block comment
--- before
<p>¦a</p>
--- keys
<bc>
--- after
<!-- <p>¦a</p> -->

=== line comment falls back to block
--- before
«<p>a</p>»
--- keys
<lc>
--- after
«<!-- <p>a</p> -->»

=== line comment unwrap
--- before
«<!-- <p>a</p> -->»
--- keys
<lc>
--- after
«<p>a</p>»

=== text apostrophe
--- before
<p>don¦</p>
--- keys
't
--- after
<p>don't¦</p>

=== surround
--- before
<p>«a»</p>
--- keys
(
--- after
<p>(«a»)</p>

=== indent nested
--- before
<ul>
  <li>¦</li>
</ul>
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
<ul>
  <li>
      ¦
  </li>
</ul>

=== script braces
--- before
<script>
function f() {¦}
</script>
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
<script>
function f() {
¦}
</script>

=== no autoclose in comment
--- before
<!-- ¦ -->
--- keys
(
--- after
<!-- (¦ -->
